svg.title: What the assistant does when a call to GitHub fails
svg.desc: A call to GitHub that succeeds lets the run go on. Not found means that the thing doesn't exist, and it is left out. A secondary rate limit runs the call again after a minute, up to three times. A server error runs a read again after 2, 4 and 8 seconds. Every other error, and one that stays, stops the run with one error that names what it wrote; running it again completes the rest without a second comment.
